problems_and_friction: No real friction: clan agent-help plus the embedded agent guide in doc.clan made the protocol discoverable in two commands. Mild uncertainty about whether pack-html could write to the same path as its input, so I packed to doc-next.clan and moved it over the original; lineage (parent id) was preserved correctly. The only judgment call was choosing pack-html with YAML frontmatter over emitting raw JSON, which the guide itself recommends as the token-cheaper path. The no-web constraint means all EUR pricing is knowledge-cutoff list pricing and is flagged as such in the document assumptions.
context_understood: I am hop 1 of 3: produce comparative market research (capabilities, EUR pricing for 40 seats, strengths/weaknesses, ad-ops integration fit) on Salesforce vs HubSpot vs Zoho CRM for Brightline, a Dublin ad agency, writing it into doc.clan via the clan CLI for a downstream risk-analyst.
